metadata.tes:contract:
== TESSERACT RENDERER · AGENT CONTRACT ==
You are an agent walking this DAG-of-DAGs. The master SVG is BOTH the document and the executable plan.
To advance through one node you MUST satisfy these THREE requirements:
1. IDENTIFY THE NODE Set the node's data-walk-id to the canonical node id and data-walk-by to your agent identifier. Confirms you read it.
2. IDENTIFY EVERY ADJACENT NODE List the IDs of every node connected to this one (edges in either direction) into data-walk-neighbors as JSON.
3. MAP THE SUBJECT MATTER AT EACH LAYER Record into data-walk-subjects a JSON dict like: { "dag": "<which DAG owns the node>", "subsystem": "<which subsystem (if any) this serves>", "project_types": ["<which project types this is reachable from>"] }
Only when all three attributes are populated may the walker mark data-walk-state="processed" and advance. Walk every node across all DAGs to complete the operations pass.
Use cc -tesseract-walk to fetch the next pending node and the exact requirements for it. Use cc -tesseract-identify <node-id> ... to submit your three answers.
== STATUS COLORS == green = implemented yellow = partial implementation orange = stub gray = placeholder (no code yet)
== LAYERS == 0 instructions (this text) visible 1 systems subsystem tiles visible 2 dag_of_dags cluster overview visible 3 nodes every node visible (zoom for detail) 4 project_types switchboard visible 5 plan steps tracker visible
== HOW TO REGENERATE == cc -tesseract-build
